patterns.what_worked: Reading the APLs as three row classes (rotation / sim-harness / prepull) made the operator's request answerable without inventing a scope, and made the open question crisp.
patterns.what_was_hard: Deciding whether the harness rows belong in a rotation table is a product call, not a source fact - the APL itself does not settle it.
patterns.skill_gap: When a brief says 'add the missing lines', the row-granularity of the source matters as much as the content.

escalation.reason: HU-12: should the shipped practice_rotation tables carry the APL's SPELL rows only (with a per-class prepull table) or the FULL APL including consumables/trinkets/potions? The second reading needs new options toggles (no default-visible change without an explicit gate) and makes the rotation display a 'press my trinkets' list. The operator's own example lines (Charge, Battle Stance, Blood Rage) sit on the prepull/upkeep side of that split, so the choice changes where they land.
escalation.recommendation: Rule (i): the rotation table keeps the APL's spell-decision rows; a per-class prepull/upkeep table (the hunter's existing ST.HUNTER.PRACTICE_PREPULLS shape) takes the prepull and utility rows. Sim-harness rows (trinkets, Engineering, autocastOtherCooldowns, potions) stay out of both - they are not rotation decisions.
